items.headline:
US bond market volatility is at historic levels.

The MOVE index jumped +19% last week, its largest weekly increase since April 2025, following "Liberation Day."

This index is also called the "VIX of bonds" and measures the yield volatility of 2Y, 5Y, 10Y, and 30Y Treasuries.

Mortgage rates were 3.5%

Inflation was under 2%

Gas is almost $5 a gallon
Inflation is 3.4%
Unemployment is now over 4%

What happened?
